findings.status: observed; structural proposal deferred until post-port review
findings.observation: At recorded baseline c827c4e6, the presentation spanned 1,399 lines and Runtime 960 lines, with shell, workspace routing, data/service actions and lifecycle integration sharing these modules; the reference Workbench was 1,426 lines. These are historical measurements, not current line counts. Length alone is not a defect; the concrete cost is that independent workflow edits repeatedly touch the same ownership surface.
findings.impact: Concurrent changes can conflict, and a one-to-one port could preserve broad coupling between workspace controls and service lifecycles.
